context: Editorial all six built-in email templates, subjects and complete bodies: verification/reset expiry, invitation role and temporary credentials, account restriction, site/live moderation assignment. Arabic, Japanese, Korean, three Chinese variants, Turkish, Indonesian and Malaysian Malay. Friendly direct language, ordinary JP/KO grammar without customer honorifics. Named tokens, literal role/title/user values and all functional meanings preserved; administrator overrides untouched. Numeric expiry phrased as a labelled duration or native invariant units to avoid false plural assembly.
